summary: We are first-year students at Amal Jyothi College of Engineering, Kerala, India. We've taken this opportunity to explore our horizons in coding and web development. We've built this webpage in order to provide the audience an immersive experience in looking back at various deserted objects in outer space. This project has been made carefully with aspects such as the story being comprehensible to all ages in mind.
details:
Our project is an interactive, digital storybook that brings the history of space exploration to life through a robot named Tilly. Readers discover various real-life incidents where objects have been abandoned in space either for research or to make the trip back home easier. We were able to include a few of the many objects that were left behind in both the moon and Mars. The story also tries to bring immersive conversations by our main character, Tilly, which makes our story feel interactive to all ages.

We've used VSCode to build our html file and GitHub to host the webpage.
